Name: Pufferfish Chickens
Author: gzhynko
Description:
This mod adds Pufferfish chicken as a new coop animal with its own eggs, which can be turned into the Pufferfish mayonnaise.

The pufferfish egg can be obtained from Willy in a new event which occurs on the Farm map if the following conditions are met:
[list]
[*]The weather is sunny.[/*]
[*]The player has at least one free inventory slot.[/*]
[*]The player has at least 50 friendship points with Willy.[/*]
[*]The player have played for at least 42 days.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Note: [/b]Translations are not accepted.

[size=4]Installation[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿﻿.[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3296][/url][/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]

[size=4]Uninstallation[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Get rid of all the items this mod adds (Pufferfish eggs and Pufferfish mayonnaise).[/*]
[*]Sell all the Pufferfish chickens.[/*]
[*]Proceed with removing the mod folder.[/*]
[/list]

[size=4]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Compatible with SMAPI 4.2 and higher (the latest version is recommended).[/*]
[*]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6 and higher.[/*]
[/list]

Pufferfish Chickens is [url=https://github.com/gzhynko/StardewMods/tree/master/Pufferfish%20Chickens]open-source[/url] and is licensed under the [url=https://github.com/gzhynko/StardewMods/blob/master/LICENSE]0BSD License[/url]﻿.
